one_month_reasoning: No AAOI earnings print falls in the window: Q3 2026 results are estimated for ~2026-11-05 (source 14), prior Q3 item 2.02 8-Ks came 2025-11-06 and 2024-11-07, and no date-setting 8-K had been filed by 2026-10-03 (source 22); I put ~5-10% on an in-window print or pre-announcement. Events inside the window: (1) hyperscaler Q3 earnings and 2027 capex commentary in the last week of October, a two-sided jump risk given 92% top-3 customer concentration; (2) continued sales under the $600M ATM (source 3), a steady mild overhang; (3) insider 10b5-1 sales (source 4), minor; (4) positioning into the Q4 guide that must show ~$485M to keep the ~$1.1B FY26 target, a test that lands just after the window. Short interest is ~15% of float (source 14). With no scheduled company catalyst I stay close to a symmetric lognormal at monthly vol ~0.38 (139%/3.5 trimmed slightly), with a small negative drift (median ~$114.5 vs $115.59) for the ATM overhang.

fair_value.method: Value at the horizon (Oct 2027) on NTM EPS/EBITDA (25% CY27 + 75% CY28): P/E $4.60 x 19x = $87.4 and EV/EBITDA $671M x 13.5x + $0.25B net cash over 97.5M diluted shares = $95.5, blended 50/50 to ~$91. Both multiples are the CY27 10-peer medians (26.0x P/E, 18.1x EV/EBITDA) less ~15% for peer multiple compression by the horizon and a ~12% persistent AAOI discount.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM-at-horizon EPS $4.60 (0.25 x CY27 $3.55 + 0.75 x CY28 $4.95) x 19x (peer CY27 median 26.0x, x0.85 compression, x0.88 AAOI discount)

inputs_detail.derivation: Revenue $2.4B (about 10% below the $2.66B consensus, source 13, because the Q4 2026 step to ~$485M implied by the ~$1.1B FY26 target is unproven, source 1) x 31% non-GAAP GM (Q1 29.2%, Q2 29.8%, Q3 guide 29-30.5%, sources 1, 16) = $744M; less non-GAAP opex ~$330M (GAAP opex $77.9M/qtr in Q2 incl. SBC, source 1, scaled up for new Texas/Ningbo sites); interest ~$5M; 15% tax = ~$346M over 97.5M diluted shares. Note Q2 non-GAAP EPS of $0.06 rested on a $14.3M tax add-back with Adjusted EBITDA -$0.5M (source 1), so margin leverage is still a forecast, not a fact.
Revenue $3.0B (+25%, 930k units/month capacity target for end-2027 per source 1) x 32% GM less ~$380M opex, 15% tax = ~$490M over ~99M shares.

84.91M outstanding 2026-08-20 (source 3) + ~5.2M from the $600M ATM at ~$115 + 2.88M from the 2030 converts ($124.9M x 23.0884/1,000) + ~1.0M treasury-method from the 1,324,233 vested Amazon warrant shares at $23.70 (the other 6.62M vest only with up to $4B of Amazon purchases over 10 years, 10-Q Note 3, source 2) + ~1.7M RSU/PSU + ~2M for further issuance given H2 capex.

10-peer CY27 P/E median 26.0x (range 10.9-47.8x, sources 19-21). By Oct 2027 the market prices NTM (mostly CY28) earnings, when peer growth decelerates from the ~55% CY27 median; the leading module makers Innolight and Eoptolink already trade at 11-12x CY27, showing the market capitalises peak-cycle optics earnings at low multiples, so I take ~15% compression (26 x 0.85 = 22x). A further ~12% AAOI discount (22 x 0.88 = 19.4x, rounded to 19x) for structural factors that persist through the horizon: top-3 customers 92% of revenue, negative FCF funded by three equity programs in 2026, no operating profit yet (sources 1, 2, 3, 18).

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM-at-horizon EBITDA $671M (0.25 x CY27 $524M + 0.75 x CY28 $720M) x 13.5x = $9.06B EV + $0.25B net cash = $9.31B / 97.5M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Operating income ~$414M from the EPS bridge plus D&A ~$110M as >$600M of H1 2026 capex and prepayments (source 2) start depreciating; built up from a starting Adjusted EBITDA of -$0.5M in Q2 2026 (source 1), so it requires the Q4 2026 revenue step to land.
Operating income ~$580M on $3.0B revenue plus D&A ~$140M.

10-peer CY27 EV/EBITDA median 18.1x (proxy: trailing EV/EBITDA x CY27 P/E / trailing P/E; range 6.9-44.1x), x0.85 for compression by the horizon = 15.3x, x0.88 for the same persistent AAOI discount = 13.5x.

$508.8M cash and restricted cash less $186.4M debt at 2026-06-30 (source 1) = ~$0.32B before $33.9M bank acceptances; the $600M ATM (source 3) roughly funds H2 capex above H1's $625M (source 2) and the new leases and building purchase (sources 5-7).

bear.story: The Q4 2026 step to ~$485M fails (consensus already implies only ~$425M), optics ordering digests in 2027 as in AAOI's 2018-19 bust, or one of the three customers that make up 92% of revenue cuts orders; GM stays below 30% and Adjusted EBITDA hovers near zero while the Houston/Ningbo capacity sits underused; another equity raise near the lows. CY27 EPS ~$1.5-2 at ~20-25x.

base.story: The ramp happens but behind consensus: CY27 revenue ~$2.4B, EPS ~$3.55, CY28 ~$5 on ~97-99M shares; at Oct 2027 the stock trades on NTM EPS ~$4.60 at ~19-22x as peer multiples compress with decelerating growth.

bull.story: 650k units/month by YE2026 and 930k by end-2027 are filled at stable ASPs, CY27 revenue >$3B, GM moves into the mid-30s, the Amazon warrant keeps vesting with purchases (a sign of a deeper relationship), and CY28 EPS ~$8 earns ~24x.

comps_summary.peer_range: All on one basis, calendar 2027 consensus (fiscal-year names converted by time-weighting their two fiscal years; CIEN approximate). CY27 P/E 10.9x (Eoptolink) to 47.8x (Accelink), median 26.0x; forward EV/EBITDA (proxy: trailing EV/EBITDA x CY27 P/E / trailing P/E, LITE by judgment) 6.9x (JBL) to 44.1x (Huagong), median 18.1x. Direct optical-module subset (Innolight, Eoptolink, Accelink, Huagong, COHR, LITE, FN) median 28.7x. Fabless semis (MRVL, AVGO, CRDO, ALAB) and ANET/GLW were dropped as not comparable to a ~30% GM module assembler. Stockanalysis.com 'Forward PE' was NOT used because it mixes bases; e.g. Innolight's 15.75x and Eoptolink's 18.65x are NTM-type figures (price / CY27 EPS is 12.2x and 10.9x).
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: AAOI trades at 25.1x the $4.60 CY27 consensus and 32.6x my $3.55, around the peer median on consensus. I use 19x P/E and 13.5x EV/EBITDA on NTM-at-horizon figures: inside the peer range, about 27% and 25% below the CY27 medians, of which ~15 points is peer compression as the cycle matures and ~12 points is an AAOI-specific discount.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The ~12% AAOI discount is argued as persistent through Oct 2027, not as a sector call: (a) customer concentration: top three customers 92% and top ten 99% of Q2 revenue, with $211M of $314M receivables owed by one distributor (10-Q, source 2), which cannot diversify within 12 months; (b) funding: H1 2026 capex plus prepayments $625M vs operating cash flow of -$74M, financed by three 2026 equity programs (ATM upsized to $500M in March, then $600M in August; sources 2, 3, 18), so per-share claims keep shrinking through the horizon; (c) earnings quality: Q2's first non-GAAP profit rested on a $14.3M tax add-back with Adjusted EBITDA -$0.5M (source 1), and Q1 2026 missed consensus (source 17). Against the low-GM Chinese peers (Accelink, Huagong at 35-48x) AAOI looks cheap, but those are A-share domestic-telecom names with diversified customers and positive FCF, so I give them less weight. The ~15% compression applies to all peers and is not an AAOI discount: Innolight/Eoptolink at 11-12x CY27 show that the market already discounts peak-cycle optics earnings. No premium is argued; US/Texas capacity as a tariff/China-restriction hedge is possible upside but is not yet visible in pricing or margins.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$60 (about 17x my $3.55 CY27 EPS, EV ~$5.6B, and well below the 2026 drawdown lows of ~$76-94), the market would be pricing CY27 EPS near $2 or less. Most likely causes: the Q4 2026 revenue step fails badly, a hyperscaler program is lost or cut (top-3 concentration 92%), 1.6T qualification fails, or a funding squeeze forces a deeply dilutive raise. That would mean the ramp thesis itself failed, not ordinary 139%-vol noise.

reasoning: Skeptic lane, round 2. The supervisor's findings are mostly confirmed, and I adopt them: (1) only 1.32M Amazon warrant shares are vested, so diluted shares fall from ~100M to 97.5M (+3% per share); (2) Q2's non-GAAP profit rested on a $14.3M tax add-back with Adjusted EBITDA -$0.5M, which strengthens my haircut of the $4.60 CY27 consensus to $3.55; (3) FY26 ~$1.1B needs ~$485M in Q4; (4) net cash ~$0.25B. I sourced my old 'Q1 miss' claim: Q1 non-GAAP EPS was -$0.07 vs -$0.05 consensus, and revenue was ~3.4% below consensus in the lower half of guidance (8-Ks and Weiss Ratings). Comps: I rebuilt a 10-peer set on a single CY2027 basis from consensus EPS and prices. The median is 26.0x P/E (18.1x EV/EBITDA proxy), not the supervisor's ~21x, because its Innolight/Eoptolink figures were NTM-type; on CY27 they are 12.2x and 10.9x. That cheapness of the scale leaders is itself skeptic evidence: the market already capitalises peak-cycle optics earnings at low multiples. So I value AAOI at the horizon on NTM (mostly CY28) figures at the peer median less ~15% compression and a ~12% persistent discount (concentration, funding, earnings quality). P/E gives $87 and EV/EBITDA $96, so fair value is ~$91 (round 1: $93). Scenarios are bear $45 (28%), base $98 (47%) and bull $195 (25%); the mixture of lognormals gives a mean of $107 and a median of ~$100, and P(>= spot) falls to 0.39 from 0.42. The fat tails reflect 139% realized vol, a $18.50-$233.67 52-week range and a 52% drawdown from the May peak. Research this round: 1 web search plus direct fetches of EDGAR and StockAnalysis pages. There are no new 8-Ks after 2026-09-17, and I found no new short report or downgrade beyond B. Riley (Nov 2025) and Weiss D/Sell.
